title: How optimistic inflow forecasts distort dispatch, prices, and contracts in hydro-dominated power systems: evidence from Brazil
abstract: arXiv:2607.00504v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Centralized hydrothermal planning models determine generation schedules and electricity spot prices based on inflow forecasts in audited-cost power systems, such as those prevalent in Latin America, and provide operational benchmarks and decision support in hydro-dominated competitive electricity markets. Consequently, biased forecasts can propagate directly into both operational decisions and market outcomes. This paper studies how persistent optimistic inflow-forecast bias propagates through the Brazilian hydrothermal power system and market. For a stylized hydrothermal model, we show analytically that optimistic bias weakly reduces water values and weakly increases first-stage hydro discharge relative to the unbiased optimum, thereby lowering reservoir storage and postponing thermal commitment. translated_title: 乐观来水预报如何在水电主导的电力系统中扭曲调度、价格与合同：来自巴西的证据
translated_abstract: 在以审计成本为基础的电力系统（如拉丁美洲普遍存在的系统）中，集中式水火电规划模型依据来水预报确定发电调度计划和电力现货价格，并在水电主导的竞争性电力市场中提供运行基准与决策支持。因此，有偏的预报会直接传导至运行决策和市场结果。本文研究了持续性乐观来水预报偏差如何在巴西水火电系统及市场中传播。针对一个风格化的水火电模型，我们从理论上证明：相对于无偏最优解，乐观偏差会弱性地降低水价值，并弱性地增加第一阶段的水电放流，从而降低水库蓄水量并推迟火电机组的投运承诺。利用巴西官方的规划与运行数据，我们提供了与该机制一致的经验证据。随后我们进行了一项合作（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过理论分析与巴西官方数据证明，持续性乐观来水预报偏差会降低水价值、增加水电放流、降低水库蓄水并推迟火电投运，从而扭曲水电主导电力系统中的调度决策与市场结果。
en_tdlr: Using a stylized hydrothermal model and official Brazilian data, this paper shows that persistent optimistic inflow-forecast bias weakly reduces water values, increases early hydro discharge, lowers reservoir storage, and delays thermal commitment, thereby distorting dispatch and market outcomes in hydro-dominated power systems.
